step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify services from visual whiteboard drawing: Amazon S3 at top left, AWS Step Functions next to it. Below are three Lambda functions titled ANALYZE, PROCESS, and PERSIST. To the right of ANALYZE are Amazon Rekognition and an ML service (SageMaker). Below PERSIST are Amazon RDS, Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon SNS.
2. Identify connections/arrows:
   - S3 triggers Step Functions
   - Step Functions invokes ANALYZE Lambda and PROCESS Lambda
   - ANALYZE Lambda calls Amazon Rekognition and ML (SageMaker)
   - PROCESS Lambda stores processed image tiles back into S3
   - PROCESS Lambda hands off to PERSIST Lambda
   - PERSIST Lambda writes metadata to RDS and DynamoDB, and sends notification via SNS
3. Format into Cloudscape compliant schema with exact service strings and logical flow order.
